accepted.title: Community Beastmen ALL versions and Slaanesh Expanded - Vassal Dilemmas are both in the list
accepted.says: Named on the maintainer's list; it can stop the third capture mission from firing.
accepted.answer: The rule comes from a post on the Community Beastmen maintainer's list: with Vassal Dilemmas the third capture mission can fail to fire, so the Community Beastmen setup leaves it out. A game that stops while loading is a separate problem – from app 0.2.0 on the app names the mod after such a stop, and you can report it from there.
